lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular blobs posterior to the gills. The first clear column contains 5 primary nodes, followed by subsequent columns of 4-5 nodes, arranged in a repeating grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly defined vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of blobs, forming a matrix of rectangular cells where each blob is positioned at a vertical stripe intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. The uppermost ridge shows the sharpest vertical gradient (high luminance on the dorsal side, deep shadow on the ventral side) and runs continuously from the gill region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 7-9 high-luminance blobs are visible on the partially framed first dorsal fin, showing a less structured, more stochastic distribution compared to the flank grid.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, lower-intensity spots. Two remoras are visible in the ventral water column below the mid-section of the shark.
